title: Chapter 1358
text:
The moment the Subduing Tree King released the power of the World Tree, all the members of the World Tree on the battlefield emitted a green light. With the buff of the halo, it was as if they had taken an aphrodisiac, and their overall combat strength suddenly increased by a large margin.

The halo covered the entire army, and the situation on the battlefield immediately changed. All the members of the World Tree army were given a buff, and they immediately charged forward. Many of the three Universal Civilizations' troops, who were still in a stalemate, were instantly heavily injured, and their losses soared.

The Beyond Grade As were the first to feel the change. The increase in the overall strength of the World Tree experts immediately broke the stalemate. Many of the Beyond Grade As who were originally in a stalemate with their opponents had the initiative taken away, and they fell into a disadvantage in the blink of an eye. Many of them were in danger, and their lives were in danger.

Golden rays of light shot out frequently, landing on the Beyond Grade As who were in danger one after another. At the critical moment, they provided a mouthful of good milk, allowing a large number of Beyond Grade As to catch their breaths. However, the World Tree experts also reacted. They used various methods to try to disperse or isolate the life energy that shot over, preventing this recovery-type Esper from healing his companions.

Only Hella had a soul connection with Aurora, so she could receive the Dawn of Life that Aurora instantly released. It was as if she was bound to a external source of milk. The other Beyond Grade As naturally did not have such treatment. Although the milk was sufficient, they had to receive it.

Although Aurora's Esper Ability was strange, she was only an ordinary Beyond Grade A at the moment. She could not ignore all kinds of obstructions, and this tested her ability as a healer. Not only did she have to pay attention to the life state of every Beyond Grade A, but she also had to think of a way to avoid all kinds of obstacles and successfully heal the target.

Han Xiao monitored the situation of the various regions through the quantum network. The changes in the battle were all visible. The situation was obviously not good.

"The halo of the entire army is still very powerful. Fortunately, it can't be stacked. Otherwise, the effect of the five Tree Kings transforming together would be insane …"

Han Xiaoxin's eyes locked onto the Subduing Tree King.

Only by killing the Subduing Tree King could he remove the enemy's halo and turn the situation around. Otherwise, the overall losses on his side would increase exponentially.

However, at this moment, the Subduing Tree King, who had been strengthened by releasing the power of the World Tree, retreated instead of advancing. He retreated and dodged into the heavy protection of the World Tree fleet. At the same time, he retracted the eye-catching World Tree Roots into his body and had no intention of charging forward to fight Han Xiao.

Han Xiao's expression immediately changed, and his emotions surged.

He had thought that the Subduing Tree King would charge forward to continue the battle after transforming and try to defeat him. He did not expect the other party to avoid the battle after going all out.

If you're not going to fight, you should have said so earlier. You're so aggressive that it makes my blood boil.

"This is bad. If I don't get rid of him quickly, it'll be troublesome …"

Han Xiao felt helpless.

After transforming, the Tree King had an extremely high strategic value. He no longer put himself in danger and hid in the fleet, continuing to provide bonuses to the army. This was a calm approach, but such a situation rarely happened in his previous life. It was not easy for the Tree King to release the power of the World Tree, so his fighting spirit also soared. Usually, he would fight to his heart's content.

If the other Tree Kings had chosen to avoid the battle rationally, he would have been able to accept it, but this time, it was the Subduing Tree King …

Oh my god, a Pugilist is actually not stubborn. My youth is over!

Countless World Tree battleships protected the commander-in-chief, the Subduing Tree King. Facing the seemingly endless cannons, Han Xiao felt his scalp go numb. Although he was quite confident in his tankiness, charging alone in such a large-scale battlefield was a little too arrogant.

Furthermore, the Subduing Tree King was too strong. He would not be able to deal with the enemy in a short period of time. If he rushed in, he would only be bombarded for no reason.

"If you have the guts, don't ever come out."

Seeing this, Han Xiao threw down the Subduing Tree King and turned around to kill the other World Tree experts.

If you don't stop me, I'll kill your teammates!

Although the members of the World Tree had never cared about the deaths of their teammates, this attack was an exchange. The Subduing Tree King would always care about these exchanges. Otherwise, the meaning of his transformation would be very limited.

However, Han Xiao's attention did not completely shift away from the Subduing Tree King. He was still watching the other party's movements to prevent the Subduing Tree King from using the opportunity to adjust his tactics.

The Subduing Tree King did not stop him. From another perspective, it could be said that he had gotten rid of the entanglement and used his companions as bait to lure him away. He also used his superior combat strength to attack the other Beyond Grade As. It was also a type of exchange.

"Because this is a battle of exchange, he doesn't want to waste time on an expert like me. He turned around and killed the other high-level combatants. Maybe that's what he's thinking …"

Han Xiao secretly guessed the Subduing Tree King's intentions.

At the same time, the Subduing Tree King watched as Han Xiao changed his target. His face was expressionless, and his eyes flickered.

After the previous exchange, he judged that even if he transformed, he might not be able to take down this outsider with shocking combat strength. Therefore, he suppressed the urge to attack and continued to focus on the strategic goal of the exchange … As the Tree King who had fought many civilizations, he would not easily get carried away.

However, he could not stay here and not attack. Otherwise, if he watched the outsider kill his companions, it would be meaningless for him to try to strengthen the effect of the exchange.

Since he could not stop the other party's strongest person, he could only make the same choice and change his target.

All sorts of thoughts flashed through his mind. The Subduing Tree King turned around and looked in the direction of the recovery-type Esper.

…

On a certain battlefield, an Arcane Church formation was broken through by the World Tree commandos. The formation of the frigates was torn into pieces, and the Glorious Sun Grade main ship in the middle was bitten by the World Tree assault ships. Charge cabins bit onto the main ship's hull one after another, drilling through the armor and sending in batches of World Tree Super squads. They launched a boarding battle and tried to seize the main ship from the inside.

At this moment, the interior of the main ship had turned into a chaotic battlefield. Bloody battles broke out in all the cabins and corridors. The guards on the ship kept resisting the World Tree Supers, and from time to time, new charge cabins would smash open new gaps. The attacks came wave after wave.

"Reinforcements! Reinforcements! "

A captain pulled out the saber that had stabbed into the enemy's body, and a large amount of blood splattered on the armor's face. He did not have the time to wipe it off and anxiously called for reinforcements in the channel.

But in the next moment, a blurry shadow flashed past his eyes. Then, a huge force suddenly exploded on the side of his head. His head was grabbed by a big hand and slammed into the wall. His body twitched a few times and then stopped moving.

The owner of the hand was a burly World Tree officer. A large group of team members were massacring the soldiers in the main ship and had already broken through this line of defense.

"Head to the main control room!"

The officer shouted and was about to lead the team forward.

However, at this moment, the ground beneath their feet suddenly shook, and the cabin wall not far away shattered, revealing half of the black charge cabin.

The cabin door opened, and a group of army players rushed out to support them. Without saying a word, they charged toward the World Tree team. Both sides did not say anything, and a fierce battle immediately broke out.

After a fierce battle, this officer led his troops to wipe out this player team, but they also suffered quite a bit of losses due to the opponent's fearless and brutal fighting style.

"Do these people want to die?"

This officer frowned. He had seen people who were not afraid of death, but this group of people just now had practically used their own heads to exchange for their injuries … In his opinion, there was only one possibility, and that was that the enemy had a strong belief and did not hesitate to exchange their lives for injuries.

However, as a member of the World Tree, he would not be frightened by this kind of fearless belief. No one was afraid of death. If you want to fight with your life, I will fight with my life. Who's afraid of who?

There was no time to rest. This World Tree officer threw this matter to the back of his mind and was about to lead his troops forward.

However, at this moment, dense footsteps sounded from the corridor ahead. Another batch of reinforcements had arrived. Their appearance and abilities were exactly the same as the team that had been wiped out earlier.

"Hmm? This group of people … "

The World Tree officer was shocked.

He had already killed this group of people just now, but they had appeared again? What was going on with these people? Could it be that even if they could not be killed, they could revive like them?

Before he could think about it, a fierce battle broke out again. Due to the losses in the previous wave, the combat strength of this World Tree combat team had decreased, and they were annihilated by the same group of players. This officer was also beaten into pieces. Similar scenes played out in many battleships.

…

In the command ship of the three Universal Civilizations, Aurora released several rays of light, but before they could hit her comrades who were in danger, they were scattered by a few high-level combatants of the World Tree.

Aurora frowned and lowered her hand.

"I'm too far away from the battlefield. The opponent has plenty of time to react and can easily block my energy. This won't do. It's difficult for me to use my ability. I need to get closer and shorten the distance."

After Aurora finished speaking, without waiting for Simon's reply, she left the cabin in a flash and stepped into space. She turned into a golden stream of light and left the rear formation, quickly approaching the battlefield where the Beyond Grade As were.

This scene immediately attracted the attention of many World Tree experts. A large number of high-level combatants immediately approached this recovery-type Esper, but they were stopped by their respective opponents.

Not long after, Aurora stopped in the middle of the main fleet of the three Universal Civilizations. Although she had closed the distance, she did not step into the battlefield. She kept raising her hand to release the Dawn of Life, scattering Radiance. If the distance of the previous Dawn of Life was ten, then it was at most two to three now. The hit rate was higher than before.

Not only that, all the life forms within a certain range of her would receive an increase in recovery speed. This was the passive halo of Aurora's Esper Ability after she entered the Beyond Grade A realm. The range increased with her Grade. When she was in the command ship earlier, the range of the halo was not enough to cover this place. Now that she had arrived at this battlefield, her halo took effect, covering most of the Beyond Grade As who were fighting.

"It's very dangerous here. Don't come over!" Hella saw Aurora immediately, and her expression changed.

Aurora turned a deaf ear to him and panted lightly.

Ever since she entered the Beyond Grade A realm, she had never experienced such an intense battle. More than a hundred Beyond Grade As were treated by her, and the amount of life energy she consumed far exceeded the speed at which her life energy was replenished. Her face gradually turned pale, and she felt as if her body was being squeezed dry.

At this moment, dozens of World Tree Roots suddenly attacked the main fleet from the side. Every root contained astonishing energy, and they quickly smashed a large number of battleships, tearing open a hole in the formation.

The next moment, the Subduing Tree King shot toward Aurora like a green beam of light. The power of the World Tree burned fiercely.

He had been looking for an opportunity to kill this recovery-type Esper. The moment Aurora arrived at the frontline, he saw the opportunity and used the cover of the fleet to sneak in. He approached the edge of the main fleet and launched a surprise attack, vowing to eliminate the biggest factor that affected the exchange strategy.

The World Tree Roots seemed to have formed a giant war chariot as they charged forward, sweeping away the obstacles in their way. At the same time, they blocked the focused fire of the fleet for the Subduing Tree King. With the protection of the World Tree's power, the Subduing Tree King dug his way into the main battleship.

Aurora seemed to have lost her head out of fear. She hurriedly retreated and condensed holy light to hit the Subduing Tree King's body. However, it was as powerless as scratching an itch, unable to stop the Subduing Tree King's momentum.

In the blink of an eye, the Subduing Tree King appeared in front of Aurora as if he had teleported. His arm carried a green light as he drew a semicircle and slashed toward Aurora's head, as if he wanted to smash her into meat paste from top to bottom.

Aura that crossed two watersheds locked onto Aurora's body. Aurora seemed to be intimidated. She maintained a panicked expression and froze on the spot, unable to move.

However, at this moment, a ferocious mental explosion suddenly erupted with Aurora as the center. It was extremely invasive and almost materialized.

The Subduing Tree King felt a pain in his brain, and his fist could not help but deviate. The crescent-shaped fist shot out like a blade of light and brushed past Aurora, shattering hundreds of battleships along the way.

Sorokin's figure separated from Aurora's body and appeared behind her like a substitute. He pressed his forehead softly, and his mental energy surged out continuously. He activated all his abilities, and his aura surged.

"There's another protector?"

The Subduing Tree King's expression did not change. Just as he was about to break free from Sorokin's mental energy and continue attacking Aurora, something unexpected happened.

The panic on Aurora's face instantly disappeared, and she regained her composure as if she had expected this. The necklace she was wearing suddenly unfolded, and the mechanical structure instantly covered her entire body, turning into a set of mechanical armor that the Subduing Tree King was familiar with.

Swoosh!

The next moment, with a flash of light, Aurora disappeared, leaving behind only Sorokin and a Throne.

At the same time, Han Xiao's figure appeared out of thin air and replaced her original position. Without waiting for the Subduing Tree King to react, he raised his hand and used the Seven Heavenly Chains, hanging onto the Subduing Tree King's body.

"I knew you guys wouldn't give up, Wet Nurse!"

Han Xiao's strong arm grabbed the Subduing Tree King's neck, and he felt a huge force hitting his chest. It was as if he was hugging a big fish, and the Subduing Tree King was struggling in his arms.

The Subduing Tree King had been hiding in the fleet the entire time and did not have many opportunities to attack. He had specially asked Aurora to come out. Although it was a simple bait tactic, he believed that the World Tree experts would not sit still. After all, the battle strategy of the World Tree was different. Han Xiao thought from the other party's perspective and felt that in the other party's eyes, only by cutting off the Wet Nurse could they successfully carry out the exchange tactic. For this, sacrificing some high-level combatants was worth it, and there was a certain chance of luring the Subduing Tree King out again … Although the fishing hook was straight, it could not withstand the other party's willingness. It could be considered a simple and effective plan.

The Subduing Tree King was expressionless. He kept raising his elbow and attacking Han Xiao's abdomen like raindrops. Shockwaves exploded between the two of them.

A portion of the World Tree Roots blocked the focused fire of the surrounding fleets, and a portion of them landed heavily on the two of them, wanting to pull Han Xiao off the Subduing Tree King.

In terms of Strength, the Subduing Tree King was still stronger. Han Xiao could not lock down the other party, but just as the Subduing Tree King was about to break free, mechanical structures quickly spread along the point of contact between Han Xiao and the Subduing Tree King, turning into a set of King armor that wrapped around the Subduing Tree King.

"Eat my Match Made in Heaven!"

Han Xiao's Mechanical Force flashed, and the two of them disappeared.

Swoosh!

The next moment, the two of them appeared in a strange empty area behind the three Universal Civilizations' formation. It was as if the fleet had deliberately left it there.

The moment the two of them appeared, the prepared fleets activated the protective shield around them, quickly forming a spherical barrier that covered this area. Then, they immediately retreated.

The Subduing Tree King frowned and finally broke free from Han Xiao's embrace, sending Han Xiao flying with a kick. He turned around and scanned his surroundings, discovering that there were hundreds of strange-looking mechanical devices floating in this area.

At the same time he was observing, hundreds of mechanical devices suddenly lit up, as if hundreds of wormhole channels had been opened. The interior of the channels was filled with a dazzling light, emitting a heart-palpitating energy fluctuation.

Han Xiao stopped flying and narrowed his eyes.

"A few hundred improved Keys of Destruction are enough for you and me!"

Before the war started, Han Xiao had specially instructed the three Universal Civilizations to set up this type of trap and place the throne in the trap.

The three Universal Civilizations had set up many similar traps before the war and tried to form a combination skill with the mechanisms of different Universal Treasures. This trap was one of the examples, and it was also the plan that Han Xiao had suggested — using the teleportation of the King mechanical suit and the lethality of the Key of Destruction to form a killing zone.

Advanced version: To the Underworld!

Buzz!

The next moment, a blinding light gushed out from hundreds of tunnels, instantly filling this area and drowning the two of them.
